How do you feel about {} movies?

primary_space: text -> SBERT -> concepts -> ConceptFoldNet(cv3) -> tower latent displacement from the cold fold z0, popularity-stripped; target = Wd[q] centred+stripped (item) / build_concept_dirs d_c (concept)
secondary_space: k(phi) -- IN THE EMITTER'S OWN HEAD SPACE; may not carry the claim
decoding_rule: DS_C3B_V2 reading 5 / C4C_DECODING.md ruling 1: best-of-8 by LENGTH-NORMALISED LM sequence log-likelihood is the decoding of record and is PRIMARY; greedy is reported beside it. The pick rule never consults the tower cosine -- `c4c_decoding.generate_arm` is reused verbatim and takes no evaluation argument.
reproducibility_note: the sampled arms are reproducible only at fixed batching: torch.multinomial consumes the generator per batch row (declared, as in C4C)

decoding_spec.note: SECONDARY: k=8 samples, argmax LENGTH-NORMALISED LM sequence log-likelihood. The picker never sees the tower, the cosine, R_s or any evaluation quantity.

reading_rule: reading 1 (A - A' > 0, CI excluding zero, A >= 40% of the TEMPLATED ceiling) missing on the gate channel => the vector does not condition the text once the target is a question. Reading 3 below 0.90 => the reformatting failed regardless of readings 1-2. Reading 4's exact match is expected to stay at/near zero (C3B machine-only synonyms) and is reported as such, not as failure.

incremental_persistence.rule: HARD RULE 11: each (decoding, arm) generation set and each SBERT selection set is banked to its own contract-signed sidecar the moment it completes (atomic .tmp + os.replace) and resumed on an exact contract match; a changed contract is refused, never mixed in.
